title: Figure 25. A GW Pair on Earth as Used by a Lunar Mission
description: Geometry diagram of a blue Earth with two gravitational wave sources GW1 and GW2 at opposite edges and red lines converging on the Moon. Labels give "Re = 6378 km x2 = diameter", "Rlo = 384,400 km = .00257 AU" and "θmax ~ 2Re / Rlo rad ~ 2 degrees". Page is section "4.3 Interplanetary Navigation and Geoid Mapping to 2050".
